Aviation Firm Sues Nora Fatehi for ₹3 Crore Over 'Lego Airplane' Remark

An aviation company has filed a civil defamation suit of ₹3 crore against actor Nora Fatehi. The company claims Fatehi's remarks and a video she posted about one of their chartered aircraft caused damage to their business and reputation. Fatehi allegedly referred to the plane as a 'lego airplane' or 'toy plane', which the company stated was reckless and irresponsible. The company asserts that bookings dropped by 20% following her post.
